case_classification.short_description: Very complex financial life plan model including debt, salary raises, tax (extensive) and inflation - the model is including life decisions such as getting married and having kids and the resulting financial consequences

ai_time_estimate_reasoning: This task is a highly complex personal finance and wealth management model spanning 75 years. It contains numerous intricate mechanics: dynamic salary promotions, multi-tier income tax indexing with 18 brackets, joint filing, a 'progression clause' tax adjustment for parental leave benefits, child-expense brackets that shift as the kids age (plus inflation), a mortgage amortization schedule, and a multi-phase investment portfolio with varying interest rates, overdraft penalties, and deferred capital gains taxes. Setting up the dynamic tax engine and tracking the age-dependent expenses alone will take significant time. An expert modeler would need approximately 3.5 hours to carefully build, audit, and verify all the interconnected parts.
